primary: Sum of top-level Chrome audio rendering ThreadControllerImpl::RunTask tdur plus AudioOutputDevice::FireRenderCallback tdur divided by marked elapsed seconds. Not inclusive nested sums.
normalPerformance: Equal wall-time weighting of HOLLOW, GLASS, TIDAL, ECHO, DISSOLVE. MAX/TRANSITION/CHAPTER reported separately and also as all-scenario aggregate.
secondary: Worklet FunctionCall CPU (subset of render CPU, not additive)
offline impulse response and live signal checks
limitations: One Mac and headless Chrome; not a cross-device guarantee
Offline rendering is not real-time CPU utilization
Accelerated 30/60-minute clocks and graph replacement are not a thermally sustained real-time hour
Audio thread callback timing cannot prove absence of hardware/OS output glitches
